articles.title: Pay, perks, equity: China’s AI, chip firms lead way in offering rewards to lock in talent
articles.summary: China's semiconductor and AI firms are pioneering innovative equity incentive plans, including zero-cost share awards, to secure top talent in a fiercely competitive market, highlighting a strategic shift that could reshape the tech landscape amid rising US-China tensions. This aggressive approach not only reflects the companies' response to a booming market but also underscores the critical importance of retaining skilled personnel in an era of rapid technological advancement.
